questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.
questions.explanation: 'Suggest' is followed by (that) + subject + base form, or by the -ing form: She suggested I apply.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word given.
